change: E017_aorta_huwide plus plan-1.5 augmentation applied to the training slices only: rotation +-15 deg, scale 0.9-1.1, intensity shift +-0.1, no horizontal flip, one geometric transform shared by the image and its GT. Elastic is DISABLED (aug_elastic_alpha 0), a deliberate deviation from the plan-1.5 parameters - E015_augment ran them with elastic_alpha 10 and collapsed the thin trachea (3D Dice 0.377 -> 0.081), and the esophagus is thinner than the trachea and is already the organ E017 under-segments, so repeating an elastic warp would confound this ablation. num_workers is 0 because E015 crashed in the DataLoader with workers=5. Everything else (4-organ target, split, seed, epochs, lr, batch size) is identical to E017.
hypothesis: Augmentation is the standard remedy for a thin structure trained on 15 patients: the esophagus is the organ E017 under-segments (Dice 0.229; predicted/GT volume ratio 0.15-0.60), and the aorta is the largest class so it should be unaffected. Expect esophagus 3D Dice to rise above 0.229 and the train/val gap to narrow, with heart/trachea/aorta held within seed noise (0.900 / 0.664 / 0.667).
plan_reference: AORTA_INSPECTION/aorta-findings.md; full_plan.md section 3 (aorta) superseded for a recoverable label

Aorta 3D Dice against E017's 0.667: augmentation must not cost the new class.
Heart and trachea against E017 (0.900 / 0.664) and E014_hu_wide (0.885 / 0.653): identical labels, so any move beyond ~0.02 is a real effect.
Patient_15, E017's worst case on both organs (esophagus 0.000, aorta 0.537): does augmentation recover any of it?
